hero.title: GPT-Image 2 Text to Image
hero.description:
GPT Image 2 is OpenAI's newer image model in limited rollout, built around three standout strengths: highly accurate text rendering, stronger world knowledge, and photoreal image quality. You no longer need extremely long prompts to get strong results. It can produce Chinese posters, exam papers, calligraphy, realistic documentary-style photos, and convincing UI screenshots from short natural instructions.

Need to transform uploaded images instead? Try GPT-Image 2 Image to Image.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about GPT Image 2 text rendering and photoreal generation.

q1.question: What is GPT Image 2 especially good at?
q1.answer: Its strongest use cases are text-heavy image generation, Chinese typography, photoreal scenes, professional photography prompts, and UI or screenshot-style compositions.

q2.question: Can GPT Image 2 render Chinese text accurately?
q2.answer: It is much better than previous models for Chinese text, posters, exam sheets, labels, and other structured layouts, though you should still review details before production use.

q3.question: Do I need long prompts for good results?
q3.answer: Not usually. One of the model's advantages is that simple, direct prompts can already produce excellent images, especially for common visual requests.
